name: Microsoft Entra ID Governance
short_description: Identity governance offering in Microsoft Entra that combines entitlement management, access reviews, lifecycle workflows and privileged identity management; sold as an add-on on top of Entra ID P1 or P2.

evidence.quote: M365 FM - Entra ID Governance - Access Reviews, Entitlement Management and Lifecycle Workflows
managed identities, key vault, and variety governance were going deep on all of it.
Identity governance as a business discipline. Identity governance is where security stops being a collection of settings
This is where Entra's identity governance comes into play.
Identity Governance applies the same controls across that extended workforce.
